description: Canonical resolution status for one Polymarket market (market_slug or condition_id required): market state (active/resolving/closed), UMA resolution statuses (proposed/disputed), end date and hours to resolution, declared resolution source plus sources found in the rules text, current outcome prices, UMA bond/reward and estimated payout per outcome (1.00 USDC per winning share, implied EV). The call a prediction bot makes before and after trading a market. No charge on service failure. Ed25519-s [x402: 0.01 USDC per call on Base]
name: market-resolution
